主要内容: IDEXX Laboratories, Inc. will begin selling its veterinary diagnostic merchandise products directly to U.S. veterinarians starting January 1, 2015, instead of through distributors. Henry Schein estimates that IDEXX product sales represent approximately $150 million in annualized revenue with mid-single digit margins. Selling IDEXX products is expected to contribute 4 to 6 cents to Henry Schein’s annual earnings per share, before offsetting other brand sales in 2015. Henry Schein stated that the change will have no impact on its 2014 results. The company also highlighted risks related to healthcare industry changes, regulatory compliance, data privacy, global operations, acquisitions, and litigation. It emphasized that these factors are not exhaustive and many are beyond its control.
